test_title: PYST 35: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 2 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The battery of the car has been used by the boy for his games.

options.text: The boy might have used the battery of the car for his games.
The boy used the battery of the car for his games.
The boy has used the battery of the car for his games.
The boy was using the battery of the car for his games.

solution:
Here the correct answer is **The boy has used the battery of the car for his games.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **passive voice.** We need to change it into** active voice.**
 
• The given sentence is in **present perfect tense.**
 
• The **structure **of this tense is as follows:
 
 
• Passive Voice: Object + has/have + been + V3 + by + Subject.
 
• Active Voice: Subject + has + V3 + Object.
 
 
 
• **'has been used'** is changed to** 'has used'.**
 
• The subject '**The battery of the car'** becomes the object of the active voice.
 
• The object **'the boy'** becomes the subject of the active voice.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

**Correct Active Voice:**__ *The boy has used the battery of the car for his games.*
